Meerkat Investigation

By: Stenette Grosskopf | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
How easy is it to get your hands on a meerkat for a pet? And would you really want one?

Unique Selling Point:
There are many people in South Africa illegally breeding and selling meerkats for the pet market. Films like The Lion King and others have romanticised meerkats and more and more people want them as pets, not knowing what they are in for. The truth is meerkats are sociable mongooses. They bond fiercely with their families and if you keep one in your home, you automatically become one of the tribe. The meerkat will bond with you, protect you and viscously attack anyone who comes near you - because that's what meerkats do. It will need to be with you 24/7, urinate on you to claim you as part of his/her tribe, and also urinate on everything in your house as being part of his territory. Alpha females will not tolerate anyone else in the family getting pregnant, and they will not tolerate anyone else mating/bonding with you.

Summary:
Solid Earth is a meerkat rehab centre in Victoria West in the Karoo and is run by Alma-Celeste Jeppe. She takes in abandoned, rescued, and confiscated meerkats and tries to rewild them. She works closely with Lucas Lookout, a rehab centre in Krugersdorp where meerkats that cannot be re-released into he wild are kept. Lucas Lookout currently has 53 meerkats, and there are 34 at Solid Earth.

Further information:
Keeping indigenous wildlife inSouth Africa is illegal and rehab centres need specific permits from Nature Conservation. Breeding and selling meerkats for the pet trade is very much illegal. However the industry is flourishing.

We tracked down Hennie Steenkamp who illegally breeds and sells meerkat pups.

Additionally meerkats are carriers of rabies and TB. In some cases the TB causes their glands to swell up and burst. Generally they are rabies-asymptomatic, and can pose a real threat to humans and other domesticated pets.


Extra Budget Items:
Accommodation for 2 nights: R3000
And if we cover half of Stenette’s petrol I think that will be fair: That will cost around R1500 – R2000.

Total: R8200

Ballpark, since we don’t have specific dates etc

Press Release:


Meerkats Uncovered
Cute as babies, but terrors when full-grown – meerkats are wild animals and keeping them as pets, without a permit, is illegal. This hasn’t stopped some South Africans from getting them on the black market. Carte Blanche goes undercover to expose a pet trader who is buying and selling meerkats to eager buyers, keeping this illegal trade flourishing.
Producer: Stenette Grosskopf | Researcher: Laura Byrne | Presenter: Macfarlane Moleli


Script:



Meerkat Investigation 2020 SCRIPT




V/O
You see them at the zoo and if you’re lucky enough in the wild… They also feature in movies and television shows… So, of course you want your very own meerkat.


But in South Africa it’s illegal to keep an indigenous wild animal as a pet, without a permit… and although legislation differs from one province to another, it is very often nearly impossible to get the right documentation...
LINK
So don’t get me wrong, these guys are awfully cute and very very lovable, but they’re also quite vicious and territorial and these aren’t the kind of traits you’re looking for for a housemate.

Hey Baba...
Alma-Celeste Jeppe
SolidEarth Meerkat Rehabilitation Centre
They are not pets, they need each other to function, they need each other for security, they need each other for having a family. That’s how they function, they cannot function without a family.


Alma-Celeste Jeppe runs a meerkat rehabilitation centre called Solid Earth in the Northern Cape and for the past six years she’s been fighting the illegal trade, and rescuing meerkats from the pet trade because she knows what it takes to raise a meerkat.
Alma-Celeste Jeppe
SolidEarth Meerkat Rehabilitation Centre
Meerkats need at least five hours of digging a day to develop normal social skills so in an environment where they can't dig burrows and be like normal markets and socialize with each other they really become psycho, if I can put it like that.


V/O
In order to satisfy their digging instinct they will dig holes in your plaster and remove grouting from between tiles. They chew through carpets and cables… and shoes...
Alma
We've had instances where they were kept in meter by meter enclosures or cages, whatever you want to call them. And we rescue them and they literally snap after two weeks and then they start self mutilating.
They also start self mutilating while they are in the cages. They will eat their tails. They will start eating their tummies, pulling their intestines out. That’s what they do.




V/O
With the help of Jeppe and her volunteers we found some meerkat pups for sale in Bloemfontein.
UPSOUND HENNIE
Ja ek het. Ek het te koop. Hulle is R3000 een.


After some negotiation and a bit of research we hit the road.




To stay on the right side of the law we contact the Free State Provincial Government but law enforcement at the the Department of Economic, Small business development, Tourism & Environmental affairs refuses to help Jeppe, and simply refers Carte Blanche to Corporate Communications.


Jeppe is determined to rescue the meerkat pups,so we set off in search of Mr Hennie Steenkamp at his business premises in the city.
UPSOUND
Hi, my name is Macfarlane Moleli. I’m from Carte Blanche. We’re looking for a Hennie Steenkamp.

Wife: He’s not here at the moment…

He’s not here at the moment?


V/O
We decide to give him a call...
UPSOUND
Mac: Hennie, you’re speaking to Macfarlane from Carte Blanche. We’re here at Kraaines, at the shop.
Hennie: Uhmmm, Carte Blanche you say?
Mac: Yes.
Hennie: That’s impossible.
Mac: I’m being dead serious. We’re at Kraaines here in Bloemfontein. At the shop and they said you’ve just gone out for a meeting or breakfast. We want to give you a right of reply because we’ve got evidence with regards to the selling of meerkats.
Hennie; (Laughing) What did you drink this morning?
Mac: Nothing, I had coffee.
Hennie: You want more coffee?


V/O
While Steenkamp thought this was a practical joke, his wife soon confirmed the contrary.
UPSOUND
Hennie: Hallo wie’s daar by die winkel?

Michelle: Dis actually die mense van Carte Blanche en jy’s op speaker phone. So ek dink jy moet maar net reel dat jy met hulle kom praat.
V/O
Eventually Steenkamp arrives at the shop. He says he was waiting for the right documents before selling the meerkats.


Hennie: I haven’t sold any meerkats to anybody yet.

Mac: You haven’t sold yet?

Hennie: No no.


Hennie: I grew up on a farm, I know exactly how meerkats work. So, they’re well-looked after. I mean, I love animals, that’s why I’ve got them.


V/O
Steenkamp insists that he does not think he did anything wrong, especially since many people breed and sell meerkats.


Hennie: Have you seen they advertise meerkats on the internet?

Alma: That’s what we find every single day. That’s how we picked you up.
V/O
Steenkamp agrees that Jeppe should take the meerkats and rehabilitate them.


Hennie: I would have loved to keep the small one because I love him now but no problem. If it’s not legal… I don’t want to do anything illegal.
V/O
We follow Steenkamp to his house not too far from the shop.
Alma
“As ons hulle by hom kry sal ek almal gou medisyne gee. Ek het medisyne saamgebring want ek is seker hulle het ernstig diarrhea as ek kyk na daai foto’s. As hulle haartjies so plat trek dan is dit gewoonlik diarrhea. “
V/O
The older two meerkats are placed in Jeppe’s travel case and then we head upstairs to get the baby.
UPSOUND
Mac: Is he shaking?

Alma: He looks a bit stressed.
V/O
One last drink of milk and it’s time for Steenkamp to say goodbye.
Alma
“ Ek is baie bly hy het nou vir ons die diere gegee, vrywilliglik… Ons mag hom nie nou vervolg nie, maar ten minste het ons die diere en ek dink darem nie hy sal dit gou weer doen nie”
V/O
Next stop is Free State Department of Environment to get a permit to export the three critters to Northern Cape where Jeppe’s rehab centre is...
UPSOUND
No cameras...
V/O
But Law Enforcement is not happy to see us and once again insist that we deal with corporate communications, even though Jeppe simply wants a permit. She says they often struggle to get cooperation from authorities, especially here in the Free State.
Alma
The Meerkat problem is not really taken seriously at the moment. We don't always get the help that we need but we try.


V/O
As time ticks on we finally meet with Head of Communications, Mr Kgotso Tau, who spends the better half of the afternoon looking for someone to assist.
Link
So finally after six long and hard hours of negotiations with the department we’ve got the permit and we can now rehabilitate these animals all the way in the Northern Cape. We’re going to take them through to Alma,, and she’ll be able to feed them, look after them, and hopefully repatriate them back into nature where they actually belong. It’s finally becoming a good story… wow...
V/O
The sleepy town of Victoria West in the Northern Cape is home to the oldest art deco theatre in the country, and just a couple of kilometres out of town lies the property that Alma Jeppe is refurbishing for the rehabilitation of meerkats and other endangered species. It’s a work-in-progress, but she has big dreams for the future...
Alma
Where I was previously there was not enough space and I needed to expand. I needed to get volunteers in. I need the program to grow to get enough funding to do this. This program because otherwise it's going to end.


V/O
Currently Solid Earth is home to 36 rescued meerkats. They are carefully paired with other individuals to make families of 5 or more, and as soon as they prove to be a close knit unit, they are released in the wild. Although small, they are vicious and can easily kill each other or turn on their human carers.
Eljay Samson
Die is die mannetjie. Hy is die kwaai enetjie.

Mac: Byt hy vir almal, die een?

Ja. Hy byt. Vir hom is ek maar baie versigtig.
V/O
Eljay Samson has been helping Jeppe at the rehab centre. They keep a daily register of everything. Caring for meerkats is a full-time job.
Eljay Samson
“ I really enjoy working with the meerkats and I look forward to working with other animals in the future”
Upsound Alma
Mac: This baby has travelled six hours and he’s finally made it.

Yes.

Mac: If we hadn’t brought this guy in yesterday, what would have happened to him?

He would have died. He’s sick.




V/O
Steenkamp’s lack of meerkat expertise and the additional 10-hour journey to get to Solid Earth has taken its toll on this little body.


Mac: have you given him a name yet?

Alma: Well I hear the producer has given the name Willoughby.

Mac: Okay Willoughby...
V/O
Willoughby is not very keen on the mineral and calcium solution that Jeppe tries to feed him.
UOPSOUND
No child likes medicine, even a meerkat child.
V/O
Up until now the baby has only been fed milk, but Jeppe is changing his diet to a high-protein feed.
UPSOUND
Lekker
V/O
But Willoughby is not doing too well and despite the treatment, he’s getting weaker by the minute.
Alma
We need to get his electrolytes up as soon as possible...
V/O
That means a drip under the skin and Doctor Mac is standing by...
UPSOUND
Alma: Okay

Mac: Here goes nothing. I’ve never been so nervous in my life.
V/O
In a matter of hours little Willoughby is looking much stronger and it’s time to introduce the babies to some friends.
LINK
So this is really a very crucial part. We’re going to see if these meerkats that we’ve rescued will integrate with the others. Baloo has been fetched. We’ve also got another one that’s running around there. So hopefully these guys and Baloo won’t fight and maybe he can look after them and play big brother.
V/o
A sterilised male meerkat called Baloo apparently makes a very good babysitter, and will help to teach them how to be real meerkats.

Within no time the older two are running about the enclosure, playing and being wild. And although the baby still very much needs to be cared for by Jeppe, he got his first taste of his meerkat future...
Alma
This is how it should be. They need to be with an adult that teaches them adult meerkat not adult human. And he will really take good care of them. He’s quite fond of pups and I’m really happy with this. Now we’re on the road to the end where they will go back to the wild and be free again.








PROMO 1 11”
At first glance Meerkats are cute but they do in fact make lousy pets. Besides being illegal to keep without a permit, they become territorial and often vicious - definitely not man’s best friend!




PROMO 2 11”
We investigate the illegal meerkat pet trade and find out why these seemingly innocent and lovable critters end up becoming problem pets, often discarded and neglected.




PROMO 3 11”
They dig holes in your plaster, and become territorial and vicious and you need a handful of paperwork to keep them. So why do people insist on keeping, breeding and selling meerkats?

Eljay Samson “ I really enjoy working with the meerkats and I look forward to working with other animals in the future” Upsound Alma Mac: This baby has travelled six hours and he’s finally made it. Yes. Mac: If we hadn’t brought this guy in yesterday, what would have happened to him? He would have died. He’s sick. V/O Steenkamp’s lack of meerkat expertise and the additional 10-hour journey to get to Solid Earth has taken its toll on this little body. Mac: have you given him a name yet? Alma: Well I hear the producer has given the name Willoughby. Mac: Okay Willoughby... V/O Willoughby is not very keen on the mineral and calcium solution that Jeppe tries to feed him. UOPSOUND No child likes medicine, even a meerkat child. V/O Up until now the baby has only been fed milk, but Jeppe is changing his diet to a high-protein feed. UPSOUND Lekker V/O But Willoughby is not doing too well and despite the treatment, he’s getting weaker by the minute. Alma We need to get his electrolytes up as soon as possible... V/O That means a drip under the skin and Doctor Mac is standing by... UPSOUND Alma: Okay Mac: Here goes nothing. I’ve never been so nervous in my life. V/O In a matter of hours little Willoughby is looking much stronger and it’s time to introduce the babies to some friends. LINK So this is really a very crucial part. We’re going to see if these meerkats that we’ve rescued will integrate with the others. Baloo has been fetched. We’ve also got another one that’s running around there. So hopefully these guys and Baloo won’t fight and maybe he can look after them and play big brother. V/o A sterilised male meerkat called Baloo apparently makes a very good babysitter, and will help to teach them how to be real meerkats. Within no time the older two are running about the enclosure, playing and being wild. And although the baby still very much needs to be cared for by Jeppe, he got his first taste of his meerkat future... Alma This is how it should be. They need to be with an adult that teaches them adult meerkat not adult human. And he will really take good care of them. He’s quite fond of pups and I’m really happy with this. Now we’re on the road to the end where they will go back to the wild and be free again. PROMO 1 11” At first glance Meerkats are cute but they do in fact make lousy pets. Besides being illegal to keep without a permit, they become territorial and often vicious - definitely not man’s best friend! PROMO 2 11” We investigate the illegal meerkat pet trade and find out why these seemingly innocent and lovable critters end up becoming problem pets, often discarded and neglected. PROMO 3 11” They dig holes in your plaster, and become territorial and vicious and you need a handful of paperwork to keep them. So why do people insist on keeping, breeding and selling meerkats?

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): How easy is it to get your hands on a meerkat for a pet? And would you really want one?
metadata.Unique Selling Point: There are many people in South Africa illegally breeding and selling meerkats for the pet market. Films like The Lion King and others have romanticised meerkats and more and more people want them as pets, not knowing what they are in for. The truth is meerkats are sociable mongooses. They bond fiercely with their families and if you keep one in your home, you automatically become one of the tribe. The meerkat will bond with you, protect you and viscously attack anyone who comes near you - because that's what meerkats do. It will need to be with you 24/7, urinate on you to claim you as part of his/her tribe, and also urinate on everything in your house as being part of his territory. Alpha females will not tolerate anyone else in the family getting pregnant, and they will not tolerate anyone else mating/bonding with you.
metadata.Summary: Solid Earth is a meerkat rehab centre in Victoria West in the Karoo and is run by Alma-Celeste Jeppe. She takes in abandoned, rescued, and confiscated meerkats and tries to rewild them. She works closely with Lucas Lookout, a rehab centre in Krugersdorp where meerkats that cannot be re-released into he wild are kept. Lucas Lookout currently has 53 meerkats, and there are 34 at Solid Earth.
metadata.Further information: Keeping indigenous wildlife inSouth Africa is illegal and rehab centres need specific permits from Nature Conservation. Breeding and selling meerkats for the pet trade is very much illegal. However the industry is flourishing. We tracked down Hennie Steenkamp who illegally breeds and sells meerkat pups. Additionally meerkats are carriers of rabies and TB. In some cases the TB causes their glands to swell up and burst. Generally they are rabies-asymptomatic, and can pose a real threat to humans and other domesticated pets.
